definitions.explanation: The total amount of money earned in a single month, typically referring to salary or wages before or after tax.

examples.japanese: {月収|げっしゅう}はいくらですか。
{月収|げっしゅう}30{万円|まんえん}で{生活|せいかつ}している。
examples.english: I live on a monthly income of 300,000 yen.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}してから{月収|げっしゅう}が{大幅|おおはば}に{上|あ}がったので、{貯金|ちょきん}ができるようになった。
examples.english: Since changing jobs, my monthly income has increased significantly, so I've been able to save money.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in discussions about salary, living expenses, and financial planning. Can refer to gross or net income depending on context. Often followed by a specific amount: {月収|げっしゅう}20{万円|まんえん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月収|げっしゅう}〜{万円|まんえん}: monthly income of ~ ten-thousand yen
- {手取|てど}り{月収|げっしゅう}: take-home monthly income
- {月収|げっしゅう}が{上|あ}がる: monthly income goes up
- {月収|げっしゅう}が{下|さ}がる: monthly income goes down

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年収|ねんしゅう}: annual income
- {給料|きゅうりょう}: salary, pay (general)
- {収入|しゅうにゅう}: income (broader, includes all sources)
